blocks.head: alt The user currently has permission at the cloud

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | (..) > < cloudB | (UserX : ('permission' : true , ...) , 'buffer' : nils , ....) > $ UserX 'publishToggle' cloudB 
= < UserX | (..) > < cloudB | (UserX : ('permission' : true , ...) , 'buffer' : 'toggle' , ....) > $ cloudB 'acknowledge' UserX .

eq < cloudB | (UserX : ('permission' : true , ..) , ...) > $ cloudB 'revokePermission' cloudB 
= < cloudB | (UserX : ('permission' : false , ..) , ...) > .

eq < UserX | (..) > < cloudB | ('buffer' : Message , deviceA : ('permission' : true , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'releaseBufferedMessage' cloudB 
= < UserX | (..) > < cloudB | ('buffer' : nils , deviceA : ('permission' : true , ...) , ....) > $ cloudB 'publish' deviceA | (Message) .

eq < deviceA | ('on' : false , ..) > $ cloudB 'publish' deviceA | ('toggle') 
= < deviceA | ('on' : true , ..) > .

eq < deviceA | ('on' : true , ..) > $ cloudB 'publish' deviceA | ('toggle') 
= < deviceA | ('on' : true , ..) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | (..) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < cloudB | (UserX : ('permission' : true , ..) , ...) > 
=> ep: ev2(cloudB) @ S < cloudB | (UserX : ('permission' : true , ..) , ...) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX) @ S < UserX | (..) > .
